Finalize NextGen output to the Lynker hydrofabric data model spec

Source: R/finalize_data_model.R
finalize_data_model.Rd

Applies the final column renames, adds VPU/streamorder/slope fields, rolls up hydrolocation attributes on POIs, and promotes a dedicated hydrolocations layer. Mutates the provided ngen GeoPackage in place.

See docs/data_model.md for the full mapping against the spec.

Usage

finalize_data_model(
  ngen_gpkg,
  reference_gpkg = NULL,
  vpuid,
  events_layer = "pois",
  events_gpkg = NULL,
  slope_parquet = NULL
)

Arguments

ngen_gpkg

Path to the NextGen GeoPackage produced by nextgen_from_gpkg + cleanup steps.

reference_gpkg

Path to the reference fabric (used to source slope per member reference COMID). If NULL, slope stays NA.

vpuid

Single VPU identifier to stamp on every layer (character).

events_layer

Source layer for hydrolocation attributes. Default "pois", the pre-ngen pois layer carries the full hl_* set (hl_class, hl_type, hl_source, hl_uri, etc). The events layer in the intermediate gpkg only has a subset, so prefer pois.

events_gpkg

Optional: if the hydrolocation source layer isn't in ngen_gpkg, read it from this gpkg (typically the pre-ngen intermediate).

slope_parquet

Optional path to a parquet of per-reference-id slope used to populate slope: either a slope table (id, slope_m_per_m) or a channel table (flowpath_id, slope_m_m). NULL leaves slope NA (default).

Value

Invisibly, the input ngen_gpkg path.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
finalize_data_model(ngen_gpkg      = "ngen_vpu01.gpkg",
                    reference_gpkg = "reference_01.gpkg",
                    vpuid          = "01",
                    events_gpkg    = "out_vpu01.gpkg")
} # }
